1,300+ lots in this week's Roanoke Auction Addicts sale start closing at 7 PM tonight. Electronics, tools, pool and outdoor gear, home goods, groceries and more, mostly new from retailer returns and overstock.

• 1/3 HP cold plunge chiller, tub not included (new)
• Brondell Swash electric bidet seat and Philips WiFi smart lock (new)
• WEP soldering and hot air rework station, 4-pack metal pegboard and Greenworks 60V 8.0Ah battery (new)
• 2 HP pool pump and Paelluxe paella burner set (new)
• 25 ft telescoping flag pole kit and air straight line sander (open box, not tested)
• 9x12 washable area rug, 12-cube organizer, nightstand with charging station and a dog ball launcher

Get your bids in before the clock runs out.

Lots begin closing tonight, Thursday, November 12, at 7 PM ET. Pickup at 2811 Williamson Rd NW, Roanoke, VA, with transfers to Galax and Dublin available (see the auction terms). Condition ranges from new to open box to used and as-is, so check each listing's photos and notes before you bid.
